import { CheckCircle2, Clock, Cpu, DollarSign, Layers3, Terminal, X } from "lucide-react"; import { formatMoney, StatusBadge } from "../../../test"; import { useTaskContext } from "@/AppContext"; const TaskOutput = () => { const { taskData } = useTaskContext(); const task = taskData.selectedTask; if (!task) return null; const agent = (task.agentId && typeof task.agentId === "object") ? task.agentId : taskData.agents.find((a: any) => (a.id || a._id) === task.agentId); return (
e.stopPropagation()} > {/* Header */}

{task.title}

Mission Execution Results

{/* Metadata Cards */}
Agent

{agent?.name || "AI Agent"}

Tokens

{task.totalTokens?.toLocaleString()}

Cost

{formatMoney(task.estimatedCost)}

Time

{new Date(task.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString()}

{/* Prompt Section */}
{task.input}
{/* Result Section */}
{task.status === "completed" && (
Verified Response
)}
{task.output || (

No output generated for this task status: {task.status}

)}
{/* Footer */}
ID: {task._id || task.id} Model: {agent?.model || "Standard"}
); }; export default TaskOutput;
